{{Quote|What say we blow this crate, Master?|Cade Skywalker to Wolf Sazen|<ref name="Legacy—War 2">[[Legacy — War 2|''Legacy — War'' 2]]</ref>}}
The '''Bombing of Falleen''' occurred when the people of [[Falleen (planet)/Legends|Falleen]] refused to align themselves with [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]. The [[Imperious-class Star Destroyer|''Imperious''-class Star Destroyer]]'' [[Darklight]]'' was deployed to [[Orbital bombardment/Legends|bombard]] the planet into submission. However, the attack was disrupted by the [[Mynock (Helot-class)|''Mynock'']], with the aid of [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], which had been sent by [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]]. [[Cade Skywalker]] with the aid of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Wolf Sazen]] managed to board the ''Darklight'' and destroy it with a number of [[Thermal detonator/Legends|thermal detonators]].
